card.name: Particulate in visual inspection statements
card.fires_on: The ending piece "ulate" of the word particulate, in the standard sentence that parenteral drug products should be inspected visually for particulate matter and discoloration before administration.

modes.label: Particulate in inspection sentence
modes.description: The word breaks after "partic" and the pole fires on the "ulate" ending, before "matter".
